# BTicino C300X Integration v1.7.0

## Added

- Configurable device activation buttons in setup, options, and reconfigure
  flows.

## Fixed

- Ring Call preview and busy state stay synchronized across multiple open
  dashboards.
- Ring Call answer events no longer toggle the C300X ringer mute switch.
- Stair-light activation events are deduplicated.
- On-demand video relay teardown is more stable after stopping streams.
- SSH installer dependencies are loaded only when SSH-based agent install or
  repair is used.
- Device activation validation now matches the native 16-item and address-length
  limits.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload all open Home Assistant browser dashboards after updating.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant to `1.7.0`.
- Use Reconfigure after updating if custom device activations were configured
  before this release.
